gloss: to shine down intensely; to beat down (of the sun)

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {照|て}りつけていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to shine down intensely; to beat down; to blaze down
definitions.explanation: Describes the sun shining fiercely and relentlessly, creating intense heat. Conveys the oppressive, punishing quality of strong sunlight.

examples.japanese: ⟦{太陽|たいよう}→太陽：03398_taiyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{照|て}りつけて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{真夏|まなつ}→真夏：27793_manatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日差|ひざ}し→日差し：00107_hizashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{容赦|ようしゃ}なく→容赦なく：15956_youshanaku⟧{照|て}りつけて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The midsummer sun was shining down mercilessly.

examples.japanese: {炎天下|えんてんか}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{太陽|たいよう}→太陽：03398_taiyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{照|て}りつけられ⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧、⟦{工事|こうじ}{現場|げんば}→工事現場：26202_koujigenba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: There are people working at construction sites under the blazing sun.

notes:
A vivid weather verb that specifically describes the sun bearing down with intense, oppressive heat. Almost exclusively used with ⟦{太陽|たいよう}→太陽：03398_taiyou⟧ or ⟦{日差|ひざ}し→日差し：00107_hizashi⟧ as the subject. Strongly associated with summer heat and often appears in descriptions of ⟦{猛暑|もうしょ}→猛暑：08311_mousho⟧ (extreme heat).

USAGE:
The progressive form {照|て}りつけて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ is the most common, describing ongoing fierce sunlight. The passive {照|て}りつけられる emphasizes the discomfort experienced by the person under the sun.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{太陽|たいよう}→太陽：03398_taiyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{照|て}りつける — the sun beats down
- ⟦{日差|ひざ}し→日差し：00107_hizashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{照|て}りつける — the sunlight blazes down
- {照|て}りつける⟦{暑|あつ}さ→暑さ：12973_atsusa⟧ — scorching heat

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{照|て}り→照る：00404_teru⟧つく — similar meaning but less common; same nuance of relentless sunlight
- ⟦{降|ふ}り{注|そそ}ぐ→降り注ぐ：07976_furisosogu⟧ — to pour down; used for both sunlight and rain, more neutral
- ⟦{照|て}る→照る：00404_teru⟧ — to shine; basic verb without the intensity or oppressive nuance
